title: Late-Return Rate on Marketplace Orders Replacement-Charge Refunds
content:
**Schedule.** The late-return rate of the Marketplace Orders replacement-charge refund counts the calendar days from the unreturned-replacement deadline to the original unit's first carrier scan: a first scan later than the option's late return grace days, or no first scan, keeps the whole charge (rate one); a first scan later than the late courtesy days of 5 but no later than the grace keeps the per-day late rate of 0.02 (2%) once for every day past the deadline; a first scan within the late courtesy days of 5 keeps no late-return rate.

The late-return rate is withheld whatever the reason of the return the replacement was shipped against. The late-return rate is added to any other rate the replacement-charge refund withholds; the combined rate, capped at the whole (one), is applied once to the refundable charge, giving the deductions, rounded half up to the cent; the deductions are subtracted from the refundable charge, and the refund never falls below zero.

## Inputs

- The unreturned-replacement deadline: the date recorded on the replacement entry plus the option's unreturned replacement days, in calendar days.
- The original unit's first carrier scan date, from the return's carrier milestones.
- The option's late return grace days, from the product's return terms.

## Rate by days past the deadline (hypothetical option with a 15-day grace)

| First scan, days past the deadline | Late-return rate |
|---|---|
| 0 to 5 | none |
| 6 | 6 times 2%, that is 12% |
| 10 | 10 times 2%, that is 20% |
| 15 | 15 times 2%, that is 30% |
| 16 or more, or no first scan | one (the whole charge) |

### Hypothetical case

A replacement recorded on 4 May with 30 unreturned replacement days has its deadline on 3 June. An original first-scanned on 11 June is 8 days past the deadline: a rate of 16%.
